extractions.description: Empirical study of inductive and transductive procedures for fitting few-shot text-classification heads over frozen embeddings returned by local or API-accessed pretrained encoders. It contributes the parameter-free FR regularizer and evaluates several classifier procedures, backbones, and multilingual classification datasets.

type.quote: We evaluate our methods using eight backbone models, along with an episodic evaluation over 1,000 episodes
type.justification: The paper runs experiments over multiple models, datasets, methods, and episodes, so it is empirical.
